reviews.text: Incredibly slow with few people on the job.

We came in at night with an acutely ill dog and felt very well looked after from the first call to the follow-up afterwards. Skilled and empathetic veterinarians who explained well along the way and took their time with our dog. My best recommendations to Empet Nydalen.

A special thank you to the veterinarians Magda and Heidi, who showed an incredibly high level of professionalism, great commitment and genuine care for Malina. We felt safe and well looked after throughout the treatment.
Thank you very much for taking such good care of Malina and giving her a second chance. We highly recommend this clinic! ❤️🐾
Thank you very much for the care of our cat. Malina has recovered. Very nice and professional treatment, and I would especially like to thank veterinarian Haidi. I highly recommend this clinic.
Skilled and nice
Got the help I needed for my dog

Very bad experience. We will never return to EMPET Nydalen.
Our cat Lucifer came to EMPET with a corneal ulcer. The ulcer was treated, but the cause was not found. At Evidensia, a blocked tear duct was later detected. As we have been explained, this led to irritation and itching and was the cause of the ulcers.
Lucifer walked with the blocked tear duct right up until it was flushed at Evidensia. So he was still in pain while we repeatedly went back to EMPET and treated the consequences without finding the cause. We believe this should have been discovered earlier, or that he should have been referred further. We contacted EMPET specifically for an eye problem, but were never informed that they did not have specialists in eye expertise. If we had known this, we would have gone directly to Evidensia.
After a check-up, we were told that the ulcer had healed and the collar could be removed. Less than an hour later, the eye swelled up and Lucifer was clearly in pain. I expressed concern several times that something was still wrong, but experienced that this was toned down. The same thing happened again later. In retrospect, we know that the blocked tear duct was there the whole time.
The worst experience was the day Lucifer was delivered at 8 am after fasting since midnight. We were promised updates, but had to call ourselves several times. We were told to pick him up at 7 pm, but due to a large number of people, we were only able to take him home around 8 pm, after about 12 hours without the planned examination being carried out.
When we picked him up, they were struggling to get him into the transport cage, so we offered to help. So we saw Lucifer sitting alone in what can best be described as a small cupboard, something like an IKEA Kallax with a glass door and lock, in a small, cone-shaped room. The clinic appeared very understaffed.
We do not know how long he was there or how much supervision he received. But seeing our sick and pain-stricken cat alone there after a whole day at the clinic was absolutely terrible. To us, it felt bordering on animal cruelty.
EMPET later highlighted that Lucifer was "reluctant and aggressive". He was in pain, had fasted, had been away from us for many hours and still had the untreated blocked tear duct. We have not experienced anything similar at Evidensia.
Lucifer had to wear a collar from July 12 to August 24, over six weeks. Normally he is social and playful, but he became noticeably quieter and depressed. During this entire time, the cause was still untreated. Money can be earned back. We will never give Lucifer those six weeks back.
We are two young students and spent around 9,000 kroner at EMPET, before we had to spend about the same at Evidensia to have the problem investigated and treated. We do not have a car, and because Lucifer has severe anxiety about public transport, we have also had significant expenses for Bolt back and forth.
His insurance only has 30,000 NOK in veterinary coverage, which is now almost used up. We do not expect free treatment, but react strongly to paying thousands at EMPET without the cause being found, and then having to pay about the same amount at Evidensia. We feel drained of money unnecessarily.
The complaint handling has made us even more dissatisfied. Sent a formal complaint at the end of July and only on August 19th were we contacted by a male veterinarian and were promised a written response that evening, as we could not reach an agreement over the phone. 12 days later we still have not received any response, and yesterday, August 31st, we had to call again ourselves. We have asked for compensation/refund, but have not been offered anything.
We are left with a cat that was in pain for weeks, large veterinary and transport costs and an insurance that is almost used up. We feel let down as pet owners and financially exploited. We believe EMPET should take responsibility and compensate us, and cannot recommend EMPET Nydalen. After speaking with other pet owners who have experienced similar situations, I am very concerned about how this animal shelter is run.
God service👍 …
Long waiting times, unpleasant and unserviceable staff/veterinarians, expensive prices, absolutely not recommended.
What a safe place for animals and people. Professional staff. Easy to find.
Skilled cardiologist. Felt like the cat was taken care of. Decent customer parking. Go in and borrow a permit.

Last summer, 2025, we had our cat Morpheus for treatment at EMPET Nydalen after he became seriously ill – with anemia, dehydration, fever, lethargy and cognitive problems. He had FIP, a very serious disease. Despite a total cost of almost 100,000 kroner, we experienced consistently poor follow-up.

We were promised a call back in emergency situations, but never heard from the clinic, not even when we called in the evening. While Morpheus was hospitalized and under the clinic's responsibility, they forgot to give him the medication that had been prescribed for him. On one occasion, we were asked to pick him up at 12 noon, but had to wait until 4 pm – and when we finally got him, he was completely soiled in his own feces, despite a weakened immune system and ongoing FIP.

In addition, there was a constant mess in the medical records and poor continuity. Several vets lacked an overview of his condition, and when one fell ill, we were handed over to a new vet with no information at all. Knowledge of FIP was perceived as very lacking, and the staff themselves expressed being overworked – one vet said that it was “a privilege to get lunch”.

The management has admitted that communication and follow-up could have been better, and offered 10,000 kroner in reimbursement for lack of customer service, but maintains that the treatment was appropriate. We strongly disagree with this. Unfortunately, we cannot recommend EMPET Nydalen for the treatment of critically ill animals

Misdiagnosed our cat - they said he had a partial ACL fracture on his knee but he had a bilateral hip fracture. It was over a month of worry for us, more expenses, and our cat atrophied his muscles on his hind legs and was in so much pain he stopped eating. He’s only now recovering after getting surgery at another place. Don’t take your cats here.

Very happy with Empet Nydalen and heart specialist Liva Ihle Vatne. She is a very skilled and knowledgeable veterinarian who truly cares for the animals. You feel well looked after, and it is clear that both professional competence and animal welfare are in focus. Highly recommended!

Hello,

I would like to make a formal complaint regarding the treatment we received when we contacted your clinic.

On Sunday we called asking for help for our dog, who was very unwell. She was 14 years old and a much loved member of our family. We were worried and hoped to get help, advice or the opportunity to have her examined.

Unfortunately we were told to wait until Monday. We trusted the advice we were given, but our dog never got the help she needed. During the night between Sunday and Monday she died.

This has been a very difficult and painful experience for us. Our dog was not just a pet – she was a family member we loved very much. Therefore it is difficult to accept that we did not receive help when we asked for it.

We question why emergency care was not offered, or why we were not referred to a veterinary on-call who could examine her immediately. We believe that people who work with animals must understand the responsibility they have when owners contact us in despair and ask for help.

We hope to get an explanation as to why we were asked to wait until Monday, and why more was not done to help our dog.

Best regards,

Ramūnas Nazimovas
Stay away! Go to a local clinic instead. Our kitty has now been euthanized because they were afraid of the kitty.
Super service! Called in at midnight and was able to come right in, was greeted so nicely and received great help from Simen! Very satisfied, no doubt where we will go if we need help later.

I cannot say enough good things about the team at EMPET in Oslo. I drove all the way from Stavanger because I needed the absolute best care for my basset, who has a complex heart condition and had previously had a serious reaction to anesthesia.

From the moment we arrived, it was clear this was a completely different level of care. They had a full team involved including a cardiologist, anesthesiologist, dental surgeon, and highly skilled technicians. They took the time to understand her history in detail and built a careful, tailored plan to minimize risk.

Given everything she had been through, I was extremely worried about putting her under again. The team handled it with a level of professionalism and precision that gave me real confidence. They communicated clearly, were thorough, and treated her like she truly mattered.

Most importantly, she made it through the surgery safely, and I genuinely believe that would not have been the case anywhere else.

If you have a complicated case or a pet that needs advanced care, this is the place to go. Making the trip from Stavanger was absolutely worth it.

I’m incredibly grateful to the entire team. ❤️

Open 24/7, but it is questionable how effective the hospital is. None of my animals came out alive from there.

It seems that the hospital is critically understaffed. The staff are accommodating, but still appear overloaded and overworked every time. This has repeatedly led to inadequate follow-up, acute situations were not handled within a reasonable time and led to the death of the animals.

Generally unsafe experience both for the animals who depend on proper timely treatment and for me as a desperate pet owner who has to wait and chase employees; all this because of understaffing.

Never again.

I ve had a great experience with the two vets that were there today. They were both very kind and understanding . And I feel they really love animals. My cat was suprisingly calm around them and they helped me in any way possible.

Misleading opening hours – almost cost the rabbit its life
We came here last night at 2:30 AM with a rabbit in critical condition. Google clearly said “Open 24 hours”, so we trusted that and drove straight here.
The doors were locked, no response to the doorbell, no emergency phone number listed. They are actually open until 10:00 PM.
We had to spend extra time finding another clinic that was actually on duty, and those hours were very critical. When it says 24 hours open on Google Maps, you expect exactly that – especially with sick animals.
This is downright dangerous information for pet owners in emergency situations. You should fix this immediately.
Received fantastic service from a very kind vet! Dominyka at Nydalen Animal Shelter provided fantastic help and service. Recommended🥰 …

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
EMPET vet was both pleasant and thorough with our 14 year old labrador. We felt well taken care of and can highly recommend them.

We had to rush our beloved dog twice during Christmas holidays and they have been  very helpful, in particular Magnus and Elizabeth.
Unfortunately, our third trip was to say him goodbye, even in this occasion the staff was very supportive, sensitive and professional.
We experienced nothing but professional care and kindness whist our little dog Luna received treatment for lymphoma and then as she needed to pass on. Thank you
Very satisfied 👍👍 …
Very nice premises and I have received excellent follow-up from veterinarian Sara😊 …

Went to Empet Nydalen because it was open 24 hours a day and it was a weekend. My sphynx cat had thrown up 7-8 times and I just had to drag myself around when it didn't stabilize. They took both an x-ray and an ultrasound where they couldn't tell for sure if there was something in his intestines or not. It's so small that they don't know what it is. They recommended opening my cat up to see (which had cost me 65 thousand and was already up to 8 thousand for pictures), half that would have cost if it was Monday. I try to ask if there's anything else we can test first, like an appetite stimulant to see if it starts something up, since it's so small. Then I get an answer that it could make things worse. After several hours at the vet, I decide to take him home and I feed him sugar syrup via syringe for a day to wait until Monday. Suddenly he wakes up, and I give him some liver pâté. He still won't eat properly, so I have an Eyr vet on the phone who recommends that I get an appetite stimulant. After that, everything loosens up and he is completely normal again and has been since. Here I was just offered to open up my cat without ANY other options or attempts, and sent home with papers where they write that I don't care about my cat who wouldn't open him up on the spot. What a clinic!!! I have no words. STAND AWAY!
Lack of competence
It upsets me to read sad news about how a major chain fails to take responsibility for its own actions.
Responsive and good advice over the phone and helped us out of crises twice. Nice and helpful.

As owners of a critically ill cat, we expected basic care and follow-up at EMPET Nydalen. What we got, in our experience, was the exact opposite. We were promised emergency follow-up that never came, we had to explain the story to a new and different veterinarian, and the medical records seemed like one big mess.

The highlight? Being asked to pick up Morpheus at 12 noon, waiting until 4 pm – and then having him handed over covered in feces. To us, it felt both undignified and disrespectful towards an animal that was seriously ill.

When we raised this, we were left with the impression that the management was more concerned with making excuses than taking responsibility. A small refund and “we could have followed up better” were, in our opinion, far from good enough
Was well received, good communication along the way and a skilled veterinarian. Here the fur baby is in the best hands!

Yesterday I was at Empet Nydalen because my guinea pig was really bad and I was told that Empet Nydalen was the only clinic in Oslo that had a rodent specialist. My guinea pig was paralyzed and had trouble breathing. When I ran into the animal clinic, there was no one at the reception even though I called in advance and said I was on my way. I got help from another family who was sitting in the waiting area. When they called, it took 5 minutes before someone came. The vet took my guinea pig in, which I found unpleasant, since they didn't ask me what had happened. Eventually, my girlfriend and I were called into the room and we were told that my guinea pig had to be euthanized. I asked for some time to talk to my parents about what we should do with the body of my little friend. The vet came 1 hour later and I told them what we had decided. When we asked the vet what could have been the reason why my guinea pig was so bad, we didn't get a good answer. He anesthetized my guinea pig and said he would be back in 5-10 minutes, but he was gone for a good 30 minutes and there was no way to contact the staff, even though we were the only ones left at the clinic at that time. After giving the last medication, the doctor was gone for another 40 minutes and we were left alone with the body of my little dead guinea pig. In addition, it seemed that the vet did not care what was told to him and we did not receive any support. Luckily I had my girlfriend with me who supported me the whole way, but if I had been completely alone, it just would not have worked.
In addition, the vet was not a rodent specialist, but a regular vet. Before arriving at the clinic, I was told to go to Empet Nydalen precisely because they have a rodent specialist there, which was not true and I only found out about it when I returned home and looked at their website.
Even though it's a rodent, it's still part of the family just like a dog or a cat, but they didn't make it seem that way. It seemed like the vet was surprised that I was so sad about my guinea pig's passing.
Good service, good veterinarians. Nice premises 🙂 …
Very bad do not recommend to anyone after my experience
Very good quality of care.
Good energy, great people, such beautiful premises and an impressive focus on hygiene. This is what a Safe Clinic looks like 👌 …
There is clearly a lack of leadership here.

If you are considering EMPET Nydalen, you should know that you could be wasting both time and money here. The vets seem overworked and often don't have time for the patients, and the management doesn't seem to be doing anything to correct the problems. This is detrimental to the quality of treatment and the patient experience. I believe that supervision should be considered, because such operations should not be acceptable
Nice staff but expensive
Was well received and taken seriously. Possible to get an invoice on Klarna, which is often needed if you are there urgently outside opening hours.

I had a very unpleasant experience at this clinic. I came there with my rabbit, who was in bad shape – he couldn’t stand and was very disoriented. Already at the reception I asked several times if it was actually worth getting a consultation here and if they could help. I was assured that it was, and paid 2800 kroner.

After a long wait, we were able to meet the vet, who immediately said that they had no experience with rabbits and that we should contact another clinic the next morning. I asked what we should do if the rabbit died before morning, and was told that it was too late anyway. They suggested letting him stay there overnight for an additional 9000 kroner.

In practice, I paid to be told that they couldn’t help me – something that in other cases is usually provided for free. The fact that this information only came after the payment had been made was experienced as highly unethical and gives the impression of deliberate deception.

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this clinic further, especially not for owners of small animals such as rabbits.
Very good and fast service. Gets a discount due to very high price.

Fast and good help, when you really need it. The willingness to pay is high when something happens to someone you love, here they didn't take advantage of that for unnecessary investigations. Recommended.
Nice experience regarding the treatment of our French bulldog👍 …
Quick appointment, skilled veterinarian and nice staff🤩 …

I’m deeply grateful to the entire veterinary clinic team for the excellent care my dog received during her hospitalization. From the very first moment, they gave us confidence, explaining every step of the treatment and answering all our questions with patience and professionalism. The way they treated my dog was caring and attentive, and it was clear they truly cared about her well-being. Thanks to their dedication and expertise, she was able to recover and come back home healthy and happy. I 100% recommend this clinic!

We unexpectedly needed a vet while on vacation. We were helped immediately in the evening by a knowledgeable vet and provided adequate care. The bill was very reasonable, in line with Dutch rates. It was great that we could drop in unexpectedly and receive such friendly service.
Got good help in the evening
Friendly and competent staff.

Came in with a dog in a seizure. The acute situation was not recognized at the reception. In the end, the dog received assistance from a veterinarian but we were not informed or allowed to go with the veterinarian to discuss the situation. It was unpleasant that the dog was carried away without us being informed about what happened. After over an hour without knowing what happened, we got in touch with the veterinarian. This meeting was experienced positively with a lot of good information. So here the criticism goes to the receptionist both in terms of assessment of the situation, lack of information and customer service. We experienced the veterinarian as informative and good.
Got good help when our dog Nala got sick on a Sunday. Nice people who worked there

Nice and knowledgeable staff who provided lots of useful information for us as dog owners.

Unfortunately, you have to wait a long time for help after you have been assigned a veterinarian and are already in a treatment room. It seemed that the veterinarian we got had an emergency phone, and therefore had to spend more time on the phone than with us and our acutely ill dog. It was very frustrating.

Otherwise, nice and modern premises and we were admitted to the treatment room very quickly. Only had to wait a few minutes before a veterinarian came and opened it for us upon arrival.
Too steep prices unfortunately
Steer clear of the "dentist" here, she ruined our cat's mouth and then refused to give us antibiotics when he got an infection. Life-threatening place, NOT recommended!!!
Simply the best hospital in Oslo. Great caring staff and professional care.
We were there with our dog due to an emergency while on holiday and received a warm welcome and the procedure was explained to us in detail.

We have a Golden Retriever named Tapper. We have visited Empet Nydalen a few times. I must say that it is a fantastic experience every time. Such nice people who work there. Very professional and it is noticeable that they are 100% committed to helping animals. It is so nice to see people who are so passionate about our dogs. They are also very good at informing about everything they do with Tapper during each visit and I can always ask all the questions that I have (and there are many) if I could give more than 5 stars they would have. We have been there urgently once and they took him in right away even though it was fully booked. We have called them a few times and they always answer quickly and guide us in the questions we have and give recommendations. They always follow up the visit to check the status with Tapper. I can highly recommend this vet and all the people who work there. Everyone is really good but an extra thank you to a girl who I think is called Amalie. I have had contact with her and she is truly a star and it is noticeable that she has a big heart for animals.
Very good veterinarian.

My cat got diabetes 3 weeks ago, and was sent immediately to this hospital after being examined by my regular vet. From the first step in the hospital, I have felt that they took good care of both my cat and me. Everyone I have met is kind, and they love animals but also people. My cat, who is very cuddly with me but very shy otherwise, cuddled a lot with the one woman who worked there. I have called them maybe 50 times at all possible times of the day and they always answer the phone and help, they are so patient. This is the first time I have written a recommendation for an animal hospital even though I have been to several over the years. It is always cold and scary to be there, but at Empet Nydalen, even if you are afraid for your animal, you know that they do everything they can so that the animal does not feel too bad, and they are so kind to us owners too. In addition, they always remember my cat's name. I am so grateful to the entire team who have all been so kind and patient.

Professional and considerate.
Focus on the animal's welfare, but also on taking care of the owners.
Thorough, skilled, friendly. Very good follow-up after surgery on a dog. Recommended!

We experienced that our little Nala had ingested some potentially poisonous mushrooms and we were quick to call the vet when we saw clear signs of poisoning. Nala was quickly accepted here and was there almost the whole day. She received good treatment and felt much better towards the evening.

So had as good an experience as we can have in such a situation, but of course hope that we don't have to make another trip.

The only complaint we have is that the vet thought we were going to get a tired little girl back, but she was her usual velociraptor self😂
We are grateful for the positive review! Thank you very much.
Very high prices for quick and easy tests. They never sent a receipt, but they managed to send a quote for an even more expensive test.
